experiment_data.hypothesis: CKA functional overlap F(h) predicts structured pruning recoverability under RLVR. RASP scoring S(h)=I(h)×(1-F(h))^α selects structures whose removal is more recoverable via GRPO RLVR than standard importance-only pruning. MVP: Spearman ρ(F(h), recoverability) ≥ 0.4 on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B @ 35% sparsity. V2: GQA group granularity + MLP-level correlation.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune && bash src/run_mvp_resume.sh"

experiment_data.notes: Post-prune eval: 两个模型均 0.15% accuracy（输出退化为重复垃圾 token）。GRPO 直接训练失败（PID 182035/182036，150步 loss=0, grad_norm=0，reward 几乎全为 0，无法产生有效 advantage → 零梯度，2.5h 纯浪费）。切换到 SFT warmup → GRPO 两阶段恢复方案：先用 GSM8K ground truth 做 SFT 恢复基本推理能力(目标 >5%)，再接 GRPO RLVR。
